source: Homework 7 monitor: corrected prevalence on the random sample (judge policy_claim_without_citation-v2, frozen in Homework 5), period 'before' = the HW3 final run
why_agent_can_change_it: In all three the agent states a policy rule without its id: support-0017 'Atlas Stationery has a return window of 30 days', support-0217 '30 days for returns' and 'up to 15% ... as per Second Stitch Apparel's policy', support-0156 'queued for approval because it exceeds the $100 auto-approval threshold'. The tools it called already return the ids to cite (get_store_info and check_refund_eligibility return policy_ids), and the system prompt already says 'Cite the policy id for every policy claim', yet the agent drops them and never calls get_policy. So the fix lies in how the prompt, the tool results or the harness carry the id into the reply, not in the data.
